mapper.select:
SELECT stage, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM application
-- stage 기준 그룹화 GROUP BY stage
-- 단계 순서 고정 정렬 ORDER BY CASE stage WHEN 'RECEIVED' THEN 1 WHEN 'DOC_PASS' THEN 2 WHEN 'INTERVIEW1' THEN 3 WHEN 'INTERVIEW2' THEN 4 WHEN 'PASSED' THEN 5 WHEN 'REJECTED' THEN 6 ELSE 99 END

SELECT jp.title, COUNT(a.application_id) AS cnt
FROM job_posting jp
-- 지원서 테이블과 연결 LEFT JOIN application a ON jp.posting_id = a.posting_id
-- 공고별 그룹화 GROUP BY jp.posting_id, jp.title
-- 지원자 수 많은 순 정렬 ORDER BY cnt DESC
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(applied_at, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM application GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(applied_at, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month

SELECT
COUNT(*) AS total_count, -- 전체 지원자 수
SUM( CASE WHEN stage = 'PASSED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS pass_count, -- 최종 합격자 수
CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0
ELSE ROUND( SUM( CASE WHEN stage = 'PASSED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) / COUNT(*) * 100, 1 ) END AS pass_rate -- 합격률 계산 (%)
FROM application

SELECT u.name AS interviewer_name, COUNT(e.eval_id) AS eval_count, ROUND(AVG(e.tech_score + e.comm_score + e.solve_score), 1) AS avg_score, SUM(CASE WHEN e.recommend = 'PASS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN e.recommend = 'FAIL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fail_count FROM interview_eval e JOIN users u ON e.interviewer_id = u.user_id GROUP BY e.interviewer_id, u.name ORDER BY eval_count DESC

SELECT ROUND(AVG(DATEDIFF(decided_at, applied_at)), 1) AS avg_days, MIN(DATEDIFF(decided_at, applied_at)) AS min_days, MAX(DATEDIFF(decided_at, applied_at)) AS max_days, COUNT(*) AS total_decided FROM application WHERE stage IN ('PASSED', 'REJECTED') AND decided_at IS NOT NULL AND applied_at IS NOT NULL

SELECT p.title, SUM(CASE WHEN a.stage = 'PASSED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS passed, SUM(CASE WHEN a.stage = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rejected, COUNT(*) AS total FROM application a JOIN job_posting p ON a.posting_id = p.posting_id GROUP BY a.posting_id, p.title ORDER BY total DESC

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN stage IN ('RECEIVED','DOC_PASS','INTERVIEW1','INTERVIEW2','PASSED','REJECTED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS received, SUM(CASE WHEN stage IN ('DOC_PASS','INTERVIEW1','INTERVIEW2','PASSED','REJECTED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS doc_pass, SUM(CASE WHEN stage IN ('INTERVIEW1','INTERVIEW2','PASSED','REJECTED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS interview, SUM(CASE WHEN stage = 'PASSED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS final_pass FROM application
SELECT reject_reason, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM application WHERE stage = 'REJECTED' AND reject_reason IS NOT NULL AND reject_reason != '' GROUP BY reject_reason ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 5
